## Activity

During April 2020, Harbour Eye Clinic recorded 149 captures. This represents the total capture activity reported for the month. The activity level provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes across the service. Records were processed through the usual operational pathway, with captures subsequently assessed for suitability and clinical findings.

## Image quality

Of the 149 captures, 6 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 4.0 per cent. These images could not be used for a reliable grading outcome and should be considered when reviewing local image acquisition and capture processes. The result provides a clear indication of the proportion of activity affected by image quality during April 2020.

## Grading

Grading identified 29 referable results. These outcomes require the appropriate follow-up under the established clinical pathway. The median lag between capture and grading was 1 day. Overall, the grading activity was completed with a short median interval, while the number of referable results and the ungradable images should continue to be monitored as part of routine site operations.
